hypothesis: M192 produced a fresh robustness-passing current-family boundary wrong-history surface for M184, M188, and M189. Before any stage4 PPO or actor update, the accepted rows must be converted into replay-aligned boundary-outcome corpora and objective sanity artifacts, with M189 treated as the current-best source checkpoint.
success_criteria: build boundary-outcome corpora only from M192 robustness-passing accepted wrong-history rows
build at least the current-best M189 corpus; optionally build M184/M188 family corpora for comparison
deduplicate or cap rows by strict physical pair so no single pair dominates
keep actor inputs unchanged and use relocated outcomes only as training-time labels
prove objective-only improvement across at least three optimization seeds
run replay sanity before admitting any guarded actor update or PPO continuation
failure_criteria: run stage4 PPO directly from M192
mix hidden-state spaces inside one corpus
accept objective loss improvement without replay alignment
